mods.name: Nuclearistic Core
mods.description:
Nuclearistic Core is a project that adds new resources, simplifies their extraction and processing, and introduces for the first time... biotechnologies [not yet implemented; to be added in future versions].
Copyright kirsan122. Do not distribute!

releases.notes:
## Changes

> First, let's talk about the changes so you can better understand why the 3 new machines are needed.

* The oil recipe for the Distillation Tower has been changed — now, distilling oil yields Associated Petroleum Gas, Naphtha, Heavy Naphtha, and Mazut.
* The energy buffers of machines have been updated — they now store a balanced amount of energy that matches each machine's tier in the mod's progression. A similar update applies to fluids: the fluid buffers of machines have been adjusted (this does not apply to the Fluid Tank).
* The crafting recipes for all machines have been changed, except for the Electric Furnace and the Crusher. In machine recipes that previously required a Fluid Tank, you will now need new items — sheets. We will cover this in more detail below.
## New Additions
### New Fluids
* Added new fluids: **Naphtha**, **Heavy Naphtha**, **Kerosene**, **Methane**, **Ethane**, and **Ethylene**. **Associated Petroleum Gas** was already present in the code earlier, though I had to put it on hold due to release deadlines. Now it is finally ready and obtainable in-game!
New Blocks
* Added a new machine — **Catalytic Reformer**. It consumes 45 FE/t, has a 12 kFE energy buffer, and features 3 tanks with a capacity of 8 buckets each. Its sole purpose (for now, as more recipes will be added in the future) is cracking Naphtha into Gasoline and Kerosene, as well as heavy naphtha into kerosene and diesel. To operate, it requires special catalysts of the tier specified in the recipe. For instance, the two recipes mentioned above require a Tier 1 catalyst. This is the first machine from the "OBJ Machine" program; you can already see its model, though only inside the mod's files for now. I ran into some issues with loading the model and drawing its texture. I will definitely fix everything, but for now, it stays like this.
* Another new machine - **Chemical Mixer**. You might have already spotted its empty files in the Alpha v0.0.4 code. Back then, I couldn't finish it due to its complex logic (which actually delayed that version's release), but now — meet the mixer! It has a 12 kFE energy buffer, consumes 40 FE/t, and holds 3 tanks of 12 buckets each. It is used to produce Bakelite, Plastic Sheets, and other recipes.
* The final new machine is the **Pyrolysis Oven**. It is used to produce ethylene, with more recipes coming in the future. It features a 22 kFE energy buffer, consumes 40 FE/t, and has tanks with a capacity of 8 buckets each. It has unique logic with 2 recipe modes and a toggle button. The first mode is fluid-based: you input a fluid and get a fluid out. The second mode is solid-based: you input a fluid, an item, or both, and get an item as the output. Both processes can run simultaneously.
* The last new block is the Advanced Machine Frame. It is crafted using Bakelite, steel, and a Basic Machine Frame, and is used in various crafting recipes.

> Note: All 4 new blocks do not have models or textures yet.

New Items
* Added new crafting components — _sheets_ (**Tin Sheet**, **Iron Sheet**, and **Steel Sheet**). They replace Fluid Tanks in machine recipes and are crafted from 4 plates of the corresponding metal.
* Added **Bakelite** and **Plastic Sheet**, which are used for crafting machines. Bakelite is made by mixing 500 mB of Associated Petroleum Gas and 2 coal dusts, yielding 1 piece. Plastic Sheet is made by mixing 1 redstone and 500 mB of Ethylene, yielding 2 pieces.
* Added the **Tin Catalyst**. It is required for processing naphtha and heavy naphtha in the Catalytic Reformer. It does not have a texture yet.
* Added buckets for the new fluids: **Naphtha Bucket**, **Heavy Naphtha Bucket**, and **Kerosene Bucket**.
* Added the **Copper Coil**. It is used in machine crafting recipes and is made from 1 iron ingot and 8 copper wires.

releases.notes:
### New Blocks and Items

* Added new machine: **Air Collector**: Features a capacity of 10,000 FE and an 8-bucket tank. It consumes 30 FE/t and collects 5 mB of air per tick.
* Added new machine: **Liquid Cooler**: Features an energy buffer of 10,000 FE, consumes 35 FE/tick, and has two 10-bucket fluid tanks.
* Added **Raw Uranium**, as well as a **Fan** and a **Heat Exchanger** as crafting components.

### New liquid
* New liquid added - **liquefied air** (obtained by cooling air in a liquid cooler). Needed for producing nitrogen and oxygen.

### Changes and Fixes

* Fixed machine configuration, fluid tank, and the rectification column render.
* Optimized Electrolyzer functionality and its crafting recipe.
* Changed machine configuration rendering in the code.
* Changed Electrolyzer texture rendering in JEI.
* Finally fixed machine configuration.
* The Electrolyzer no longer accepts the Speed Upgrade, and shift+click support has been added to it.
* Changed root package name from "com.kirsan122.assembly_expansion" to "kirsan122.assemblyexpansion".
* Moved classes from the "kirsan122.assemblyexpansion.core.registry" package to "kirsan122.assemblyexpansion.common.init", except for the AETags class, which was moved to "kirsan122.assemblyexpansion.common.util".
* Marked the GuiConfigHelper class as 'Deprecated'.
